newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Fedsure unit '96 income jumps 58 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Fedsure unit '96 income jumps 58 pct y/y.

text.p: Fedsure Holdings Ltd chief operating company Fedlife Assurance Limited said on Wednesday it had increased total premium income for 1996 by 58 percent compared to the previous year to more than five billion rand.

Morris Bernstein, Fedlife managing director, said in a statement the increase followed a vigorous sales and marketing initiative during 1996 when the life insurer successfully promoted a competitive range of products.
"Over the past 18 months Fedlife has enlarged its product range to become one of the most comprehensive and competitive in the marketplace," Bernstein said.
Total recurring premium income increased by 10 percent, with the individual life and group benefit divisions producing solid results for 1996, Fedlife said.
The two main divisions increased single premium business by an aggregate 85 percent, it added.
Bernstein said Fedlife was currently in the process of implementing substantial additional investments in technology in the main operating divisions to enhance customer service and administration.
Fedsure Holdings Ltd is due to report year-end results in March.
